rows: CBS News
Dolores Huerta was a labor activist and civil rights leader who co-founded the group that later became the United Farm Workers.

Dolores Huerta, who co-founded the United Farm Workers, has died at 96, her family said.

Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in the nation's fruit and vegetable fields and coined the phrase “Sí, se puede!” that became a widespread rallying cry.
